name: Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building A

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building A in Ashburn, Virginia, publishes 54 MW of IT capacity, operated by Sabey Data Centers.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 5400 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 1350 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building A holds 6 published certifications: SOC 1 Type 2 (audited controls over financial reporting processes), SOC 2 Type 2 (audited controls over security, availability, and confidentiality, tested over time rather than at a point), PCI DSS (the standard required to handle payment card data), HIPAA (handling of protected health information), ISO 27001 (a certified information security management system), SSAE 18 (the attestation standard underlying SOC reports). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

Virginia has 26 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 20 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 1338.6 MW. Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building A contributes 54 MW of that total. That is a meaningful facility by colocation standards, though still below the scale where frontier AI training clusters typically operate.
